note: XVII listening-0: tears softened, period ear-tube (Ian, 17 Nov).

beats.text: Soften the tears on the young woman's cheek to a faint, barely visible wet glint on the skin: no streaks or drips, only a subtle moist shine below the eye. Replace the white earbud and white wire with an 1890s phonograph listening tube: dark brown rubber tubing ending in a small dark horn earpiece held to her ear. Keep her face, pose, hands and everything else exactly as painted.
